metrics_finding.finding: The CPU utilization of the notification-service increased significantly during the failure window, from a baseline of 0.01023 to a failure value of 0.7254466666666667.

evidence_summary.summary: The CPU utilization of the notification-service increased significantly during the failure window, indicating a possible cause for the incident.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor CPU utilization of the notification-service and consider increasing its resources or optimizing its configuration to prevent similar incidents.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to high CPU utilization of the notification-service. Further investigation is recommended to confirm this finding and implement a fix.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण को संदेह है कि नोटिफिकेशन सेवा की प्रोसेसर कुलत्व बढ़ गया है। आगे की जांच करने और इस समस्या का समाधान लेने के लिए अतिरिक्त विश्लेषण आवश्यक है।
